title: VibeFighter!
author: JoonasOfficial
selftext:
Hello,

I manifested a game prototype where everything was made with (the help of) AI: game design, backgrounds, character concepts, animation, soundtrack, and both front- and backend coding. It took about a month alongside other work... There’s more to the game than what’s visible in the clip, but the backend capabilities presented is what excites me the most.

What’s notable is that I don’t really have coding skills, especially not in backend development. Yet the thing actually works, even across devices. It’s been an interesting glimpse into how game development tools and possibilities are evolving.

As some doors close, new ones open, and exploring new creative possibilities feels refreshing.

This prototype and experiment was made possible by Nitro Games. It will likely remain unfinished, though there would be potential to develop it further. But I feel continuing would lean more toward traditional game development, with balancing and repetition, rather than AI exploration, which is more in line with my focus and role within the company.
